hero.title: Three sessions, ranked for right now.
hero.subtitle: We matched your mood to a shortlist of rhythms and atmospheres - start with #1 or explore the rest.
item-1.title: Sleep 4-7-8 + Fireplace
item-1.body: Long exhales and a warm, crackling glow - built to ease evening stress before bed.
item-2.title: Relax 4-6 + River
item-2.body: A gentler rhythm over flowing water - good for unwinding earlier in the evening.
item-3.title: Balance 5-5 + Seashore
item-3.body: An even rhythm and quiet shoreline - a steady middle-ground reset any time of day.
item-4.title: Energy 6-4 + Space
item-4.body: A brisker rhythm against a starfield - for mornings when you need a lift instead of a wind-down.
why.title: How we ranked these
why.body: We look at the time of day, the mood you described, and which rhythms and atmospheres pair well together - then order the shortlist so the best match comes first.
why.caption: Breathe out
